title_original: 국가를 당사자로 하는 소송의 수행자에 대한 포상금 지급 규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Methods and Standards for Payment of Monetary Rewards)
(1) Monetary rewards shall be paid by the Minister of Justice upon recommendation by the chief prosecutor or the head of the administrative agency to which the litigation performer belongs; provided, a separate recommendation shall not be required for public officials belonging to the Ministry of Justice.
(2) Monetary rewards shall be paid within budgetary limits, and the maximum amount payable to each person eligible for a monetary reward shall be one million won. <Amended on Dec. 16, 2024>
(3) In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), necessary matters concerning the standards, methods, and procedures for payment of monetary rewards shall be determined by the Minister of Justice. <Newly Inserted on Dec. 16, 2024>
